programmes.d: A mother and daughter are brutally murdered in their Palm Beach, Florida home as the area braces for the impact of Hurricane Andrew.
During the rainy season in southern Minnesota, an unidentified female body is discovered near the rural city of Blue Earth.
A young woman goes missing after a night out at a local bar in Maplewood, Minnesota. Weeks later, her dismembered body is found on top of a frozen pond.
In 2010, a historic snowstorm event cripples the Mid-Atlantic region. At the same time, a violent predator takes this opportunity to stalk unsuspecting victims in Virginia.
Years after Jessica Arredondo's body is found, another young woman is reported missing. Investigators uncover a link between the cases and stop a predator driven to kill.
On a perfect New York summer day, a young wife mysteriously disappears. But when a hazy detail comes to light, this missing person's case turns into a homicide investigation.
Just before Christmas 1994, heavily tattooed Jason Mitchell strangled pensioners Arthur and Shirley Wilson, before returning to his father's house and dismembering his body.
Roger and Josie Hartland found themselves stalked by their new home's previous owner, a former resident of a Nazi breeding camp who had produced numerous children for Hitler's Aryan race programme.
Helen Torbet visited the Highlands every year. Over time, Don MacMillan Junior, the son of the proprietors, developed what can only be described as an unhealthy obsession with her.
When Patricia Causley disappeared, her husband managed to convince police that she had walked out on her own volition. A decade later, detectives piece together what had really happened.
Parents of a college student have been trying to keep the police investigating their daughters murder, which took place over 40 years ago.
Newlywed Clyde Frost was found dead in his camper, a fax claimed his death was caused by a kidnapping gone wrong, Arntfield tries to track the sender.
Featuring true crime author Geoffrey Wansell as he investigates the case of a killer whose violent fantasies lead him to prey on particularly vulnerable people.
When the body of a homeless teenager is found behind a hotel, the police realise that the most dangerous type of killer is on the loose - the one who attacks strangers.
When a trunk is left at a hotel, with the address of a missing woman's parents inside, police become suspicious and everyone is wondering where the successful chorus girl could have gone.
When tenants at a house receive a note from their live-in landlord to say he has had to rush away, but to give the rent to a named tenant, questions are asked.
When a loving grandmother dies in the home of her daughter and grandson, many mourn the loss. But a tip of 15 years later raises questions that the police must answer.
Gina Rossato's body was found dumped in a ravine in August 1982. This was one of Ron Iddles' earliest homicide cases and, forty years later, it remains unsolved.
Percy Mapleton sought a quick fortune and identified Brighton bond trader Isaac Gold as his target. However, his attempted robbery on a moving train turned into an unspeakable tragedy.

The body of Rachel Manning, 19, was found dumped on a Milton Keynes golf course in 2000. In Dec 2000, 21-year-old Barri was sentenced to life in prison for murdering his her, his time in jail saw him beaten and succumb to a devastating addiction.
Louise and the team prove that the evidence is flawed, and the conviction is quashed. Yet it would be 13 years after the murder before her real killer is brought to justice.
In December 2010, Joanna Yeates was found dead in the snow near her home. Within hours her landlord Christopher Jefferies would find himself arrested on suspicion of murder.

Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire, South East England, UK, In Dec 2000, 21-year-old Barri was sentenced to life in prison for murdering his girlfriend. Louise and the team prove that the evidence is flawed, and the conviction is quashed.
Sarah Ludemann and Rachel Wade are dating the same boy. Instead of being mad at him, they take out their revenge on each other, leaving Sarah stabbed to death in the street.
When Jennifer Pan calls police about a home invasion killing her parents, investigators think she's innocent. That is, until her story does not add up and proves she is the killer.
Three shocking tales of betrayal and murder. First, a mass shooting on the University of Alabama campus leaves the country in shock.
Real estate tycoon Gary Triano is dead after his car explodes. His ex-wife, Pamela Phillips, is to blame when police discover her plot to receive his life insurance policy.

Emily Kaye was not aware of the past dealings of the handsome Patrick Mahon when she fell head over heels in love with him. Mahon rented a bungalow under an assumed name, murdered her there and dismembered her body.
